messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['You have new message waiting in your Inbox Folder.', 'PayPal transfer to your bank account initiated.', 'We were unable to verify your account information during our regular database verification process.', 'Wir haben ungewöhnliche Aktivitäten festgestellt!', 'Due to a change made to your account billing information, We are unable to process your last payment.', 'Unfortunately, Your online access has been blocked.', 'We are running a scheduled maintenance on our servers.', 'Someone recently used your password to try to sign in to your Account.', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance.', 'Your Apple ID was just used for the acquisition of "Globally" from the iTunes Store on a Personal Computer or another device that had not earlier been linked to your Apple ID.', "We've noticed that some of your account information appears to be missing or incorrect", 'Barclays is today introducing a great new offer exclusively for internet users, all customers who apply for a Barclays Current Account online will receive pound;200 cash (visit Us for details).', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by HSBC UK to inform you that we were unable to verify your account details.', 'Your Account Has Been Limited', 'We have believed that someone other than you is trying to access your account for security reasons, we have temporarily suspended your account', 'Your new official monthly statement is now available for you to view online.', 'Your money transfer has been authorized and is now available for pickup by the receiver.', 'Your email account has been blacklisted, because you are required to re-verify your account.', 'We detected something unusual about a recent activity to your Microsoft e-mail account.', 'To protect your accounts, our monitoring process recently suspended your online service.', 'You should have received a notice recently about the upcoming security enhancement on July 17, 2008 to WebBiz and WireBiz called Colonial Connection.', 'For this reason, we have restricted online access to your account.', 'We UPGRADED OUR SYSTEM, and unfortunately we have DELETED SOME PARTS OF OUR DATABASE, so we lost some information ABOUT YOUR ACCOUNT.', 'Recently, our Account Review Team identified some unusual activity in your account.', 'For security reasons, you must UPD...', 'This is to inform you that the access to your online services has been temporarily suspended due to some inconsistency within your security details.', 'We have noticed some suspicious move in your account, and we have temporarily suspended your online banking and we have issued this secure update process.', 'We could not confirm your billing address for your last transaction.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
